pack.name: Lantern Shore
pack.description: A lantern, a lost bell and a garden waiting for its keeper. Change a card and make this small world your own.

sample-shore.name: Lantern Shore
sample-shore.text: The keeper's bell rests beside the water. A path leads to the old station.
sample-shore.persona: Still water reflects a pale sky. Reeds bend beside the shore path. The old station stands a short walk away.

sample-station.name: The Keeper's Station
sample-station.text: The keeper waits by a closed garden path. A blue scarf hangs over the bench.
sample-station.persona: A quiet wooden station stands between the shore and a garden. The keeper watches the garden path and waits for the lost bell.

sample-garden.name: Rain Garden
sample-garden.text: Rain beads on broad leaves. The path leads back to the keeper's station.
sample-garden.persona: Green leaves shelter a small garden. Wet stepping stones lead back to the station.

sample-vale.name: Dino
sample-vale.text: A cheerful green dinosaur with blue spots and orange spines. Dino lights the shore path and helps friends find their courage.
sample-vale.seed: Dino is the Braveheart, a small dinosaur who brings courage to every journey.

tastes.reason: Dino shares courage with anyone who needs it.

sample-keeper.name: The keeper
sample-keeper.text: A tall figure with a clock for a face. Returning the lost bell opens the garden path.
sample-keeper.seed: The keeper cares for the station and waits for the lost bell.

tastes.reason: The keeper keeps the garden ready for visitors.

sample-lantern.name: Lantern
sample-lantern.text: A small brass lantern with warm glass and a sturdy handle.
sample-lantern.persona: A small brass lantern with warm glass and a sturdy handle. Dino carries it along the shore.

sample-bell.name: The keeper's bell
sample-bell.text: A hand bell with a worn handle. The keeper at the station is waiting for it.
sample-bell.persona: A small hand bell with a worn handle. Returning it to the keeper opens the garden path.

sample-scarf.name: Blue scarf
sample-scarf.text: A soft blue scarf lies across the station bench.
sample-scarf.persona: A soft blue scarf lies across the station bench, ready for a cold journey.

sealed.reason: Return the lost bell to the keeper to open the garden path.

bridge.description: A quiet path joins the Black pond and Lantern Shore.
